title: Route Core2 legacy I2C controllers to the shared physical board bus

execution.environment: macOS arm64, Python 3.13, Node 20, QEMU virtual-device

checks.name: legacy_controller_identity
checks.detail: All observed legacy transactions used controller 0 and /machine/soc/i2c0/i2c

checks.name: shared_physical_bus_model
checks.detail: Both ESP32 I2C controller objects route to the single GPIO21/22 board bus; each slave is attached once

checks.name: axp_rtc_ina_ack
checks.detail: AXP 0x34, RTC 0x51 and INA3221 0x40 obtain write/read ACK after the fix

checks.name: prior_i2c_bus_error_removed
checks.detail: OSError I2C bus error 19 is absent on the same firmware SHA and AXP192 variant

checks.name: uiflow2_core2_regression
checks.detail: 6/6 cases and 24/24 checks pass without retry

checks.name: legacy_stable_application
checks.detail: The same legacy image enters an independent interrupt-WDT reset/panic loop

checks.name: nonempty_application_frame
checks.detail: The retained frame remains black with SHA256 57580743a08a3f4ebdf57240cbcc997002ef63b7234531f946127f1495973f43

checks.name: core2_factory_test_after_fix
checks.detail: The historical 2026-10-24 result is preserved, but the post-fix rerun was not executed

notes: The shared I2C routing is fixed; RUNTIME-03 remains open for the later interrupt-WDT and black frame.
The routing fix is validated through the real guest controller path rather than injected register values.
No physical RF, electrical, power or hardware result is claimed.
